name: vorssaint-utils
description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
one_liner: A free macOS menu-bar app that bundles a dozen small utilities, the kind of thing you'd otherwise buy as separate paid Mac apps, into one icon.
buyer: A Mac power user who's tired of paying for and juggling a dozen separate $5-15 menu-bar utility apps.
business_use_cases: A Mac-focused app reviewer or YouTuber builds content comparing it against the paid utilities it replaces, driving affiliate or ad traffic.
An IT consultant recommends it to small-business Mac fleets to cut per-seat software licensing costs.
A developer forks the open codebase to build and sell one specialized premium utility not covered by the free bundle.

money_ideas.idea: The project itself is free and open-source, so the real business is building a paid 'pro' utility that plugs a gap it leaves, sold alongside it.
Affiliate or content revenue from 'best free menu bar app' comparison content built around it.

steal_this: Identify the one paid menu-bar utility this doesn't replace yet, build just that single feature this weekend, and market it directly to this project's user base.
